guide_blurb: The pride does the hunting. The mane does the arguing.
_tuning_notes: Savanna lion, from the Animal Garden - Lion source set (public domain). One maned male per pride is assigned at group spawn, exactly like the gorilla's silverback, and the mane part is only rendered for him — the pride leader is readable at a glance. special.pride_courage is how many pride members it takes before a lion will start on a HEALTHY player; below that it behaves like the leopard and only takes weakened or small prey, which keeps a lone lion from being a savanna death sentence. Fur is a per-individual pick from the textures list. RARITY: tier 'rare' (panda-class weight) with pride 3-4 and nearby_cap 6.
